item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29897

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 7 October 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see
Part 1
)
📍
The Tsentr Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
They inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, a UAV brigade, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, the Azov special brigade, and two National Guard brigades near Svyatogorovka, Belozerskoye, Sergeyevka, Stepanovka, Novoyavlenka, Roganskoye, Lidino, Novoandreyevka (Donetsk People's Republic), Petropavlovka, and Chuguyevo (Dnepropetrovsk region).
↗️
In Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic), assault groups of the 51st Army were advancing in central and northern parts of the city.
Marine units continued the offensive in the north-western direction along a railway. Control was established over the park area, culture house in the northern part of the settlement, and two production facilities on the territory of the Dobropolskaya mine
💥
An attempt by the 25th Airborne Brigade (AFU) to unblock an encircled enemy—with up to a platoon-sized force supported by armoured vehicles—has been repelled.
▪️
Over the past 24 hours, 82 buildings have been liberated, more than 25 Ukrainian troops, an armoured vehicle, and an pickup truck have been neutralised.
▪️
Ukrainian armed formations sustained losses of up to 520 troops, seven armoured fighting vehicles, 10 motor vehicles, a field artillery gun, four electronic warfare stations, and a radar in the area of responsibility of the Tsentr Group of Forces.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units continued to advance to the depths of the enemy's defence.
They inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of an assault brigade, two air assault brigades, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a marine brigade near Chernenkovo, Ivanovka, Gavrilovka, Kolomiytsy (Dnepropetrovsk region), Volnyanka, Nikolskoye, and Listovka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 255 troops, an armoured fighting vehicle, 11 motor vehicles, and two 155-mm Paladin self-propelled artillery systems.
↗️
The Dnepr Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
They inflicted fire damage on two mechanised brigades and a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine near Orekhov, Kushugum, Kanevskoye, Yulyevka, and Preobrazhenka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
More than 30 troops, an armoured fighting vehicle, 22 motor vehicles, and a U.S.-made 155-mm M777 howitzer were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops and artillery of the Russian groups of forces have inflicted fire damage
on production workshops of unmanned aerial vehicles and their depots, ammunition and military materiel depots, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 146 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down four guided aerial bombs and 764 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total, since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy has lost:
▫️
674
aircraft,
▫️
284
helicopters,
▫️
255,428
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
672
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
31,150
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,784
MLRS combat vehicles,
▫️
36,651
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
73,859
special military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📍 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 📍 Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region continue to tighten encirclement and expand the external control zone. Battles are underway in the encirclement for the liberation of Nikolayevka, Varvarovka, Reznikovo, Nefedovka, and Lobanovka (Kharkov region). 💥 Strikes were delivered at the enemy's formations near Kupino and Chernoye (Kharkov region). ▪️ The enemy lost up to 30 troops and an unmanned ground vehicle in the encirclement. item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29896

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region continue to tighten encirclement and expand the external control zone. Battles are underway in the encirclement for the liberation of Nikolayevka, Varvarovka, Reznikovo, Nefedovka, and Lobanovka (Kharkov region).
💥
Strikes were delivered at the enemy's formations near Kupino and Chernoye (Kharkov region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 30 troops and an unmanned ground vehicle in the encirclement. Two command posts of the enemy's unmanned aerial vehicles were neutralised.
🔥
While extending the external control zone,
there is active fighting for the settlements of Annopolye, Prikolotnoye, and Kotovka (Kharkov region).
💥
In addition, Russian troops hit manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade near Chernoglazovka, Dementiyevka, Velikiy Burluk, Novoselovka, Belashi, Cherkasskaya Lozovaya, and Goryanoye in Kharkov region.
💥
In Sumy region, strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and a territorial defence brigade near Grunovka, Kiyanitsa, Boyaro-Lezhachi (Sumy region) and the city of Sumy.
▪️
In total, the enemy lost up to 260 troops, one Tisa armoured fighting vehicle, 19 motor vehicles, a 155-mm Bogdana self-propelled artillery system, and an electronic warfare station in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
The Zapad Group's units improved the situation along the front line
and inflicted losses on the manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, an assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a territorial defence brigade, and a border detachment of the Ukrainian border service near Chervony Oskol, Maliyevka (Kharkov region), Volchiy Yar, Raygorodok, and Karpovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 220 troops, a U.S.-made HMMWV armoured fighting vehicle, a 155-mm Bogdana self-propelled artillery system, 15 motor vehicles, and an electronic warfare station.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group's elements took more advantageous lines and positions.
They inflicted fire damage on three mechanised brigades, an airmobile brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigade near Belenkoye, Semenovka, Vasilyevskaya Pustosh, Slavyansk, Nikolayevka, Druzhkovka, and Kramatorsk (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 155 troops, a Kazak armoured fighting vehicle, 23 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and an electronic warfare station.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29889

❗️
Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation launched a massive strike by high-precision ground-, sea-, and air-based weapons, and unmanned aerial vehicles to engage Ukrainian defence industry enterprises
in the city of Kiev, and Kiev, Chernigov, Kirovograd, Dnepropetrovsk, Poltava, and Kharkov regions, as well as port and ship repair infrastructure in Odessa region, and sea vessels operating in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine.
💥
As a result of the strike, the following targets were hit:
:
📍
in the city of Kiev and Kiev region:
▫️
an industrial enterprise (Smart Ammunition LLC)
in Kiev, which assembles and stores the FP-5 Flamingo Flamingo cruise missiles, FP-9 operational-tactical missiles, as well as their components;
▫️
a UAV assembly and storage site (PJSC Fanplit) in Kiev
were components for FP-5 Flamingo cruise missiles were produced along with FP-1 and FP-2 UAVs;
▫️
PJSC Kyiv Cardboard and Paper Mill in Obukhov,
Kiev region, were FP-5 Flamingo cruise missiles and their components were manufactured and stored;
📍
in Chernigov region:
▫️
an industrial enterprise (Plastmass-Priluki TH)
in Priluki, which manufactures and stores FP-5 Flamingo cruise missiles components;
📍
in Kirovograd region:
▫️
a workshop of Oleksandriya Group of Industrial Enterprises
in Oleksandriya which produces components for long-range and medium-range unmanned aerial vehicles, including fixed-wing aerial vehicles;
📍
in Dnepropetrovsk region:
▫️
a rocket and space company (Production Association Yuzhny Machine-Building Plant named after A.M. Makarov, State Enterprise) in Dnepr,
which manufactures and stores FP-5 Flamingo cruise missiles, as well as FP-1 and FP-2 long-range and medium-range unmanned aerial vehicles and supplies them to the AFU;
📍
in Poltava region:
▫️
a production enterprise (PJSC AvtoKrAZ)
in Kremenchug, which manufactures and stores special chassis for FP-5 Flamingo cruise missiles;
▫️
JTI Ukraine JSC tobacco plant
in Kremenchug, where production of small arms ammunition intended to meet the needs of the AFU is organised;
📍
in Kharkov region:
▫️
a mechanical plant in Lozovaya,
which assembles and stores FP-5 Flamingo cruise missiles, as well as their components;
📍
in Odessa region:
▫️
PSC Danube Ship Repair
in the port of Izmail, which manufactures and stores uncrewed surface vehicles and their components;
📍
in the port of Odessa,
a dry cargo ship delivering military and dual-use cargo to support the AFU.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
